contexts.text: The foulness of the external man when disjoined is here described. (Sodom.)
This is the sea of salt = the foul things of Falsities thence.
To show nakedness to the nations = ugliness; all ugliness comes from the absence of truths; and all beauty from truths.
With infernal Spirits and Genii there sometimes appear things foul and filthy... But lest the Angels should flee away, these foul and filthy things are perceived by them more mildly... SE 1995.
On the things which restrain the foulnesses of Spirits.
(The foul practices of Moravian Spirits.) SE 4794.
